name: After § 26
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26a. Underlines that European food security and sovereignty cannot be guaranteed without a fair and stable income for farmers; calls for the next MFF to support instruments aimed at strengthening the bargaining power of agricultural producers, improving transparency on production costs, combating unfair trading practices and promoting short and transparent supply chains, in order to prevent market imbalances from pushing farm-gate prices below economically sustainable levels;
